description: The factory is a repair pad (RepairDockUpdate, KindOf REPAIR_PAD) and the power plant a clinic (HealContain, KindOf HEAL_PAD): damaged vehicles and infantry have somewhere to go. The infantry have a transport slot (needed to enter containers).

edits.find: KindOf = STRUCTURE SELECTABLE IMMOBILE FS_WARFACTORY SCORE MP_COUNT_FOR_VICTORY CAN_SEE_THROUGH_STRUCTURE
edits.replace: KindOf = STRUCTURE SELECTABLE IMMOBILE FS_WARFACTORY SCORE MP_COUNT_FOR_VICTORY CAN_SEE_THROUGH_STRUCTURE REPAIR_PAD

NaturalRallyPoint = X:85.0 Y:0.0 Z:0.0
  End
  Behavior = RepairDockUpdate ModuleTag_RepairBay
    NumberApproachPositions = 3
    TimeForFullHeal = 5000
  End

edits.find: KindOf = STRUCTURE SELECTABLE IMMOBILE FS_POWER SCORE MP_COUNT_FOR_VICTORY CAN_SEE_THROUGH_STRUCTURE
edits.replace: KindOf = STRUCTURE SELECTABLE IMMOBILE FS_POWER SCORE MP_COUNT_FOR_VICTORY CAN_SEE_THROUGH_STRUCTURE HEAL_PAD

Behavior = HealContain ModuleTag_Clinic
    ContainMax = 4
    AllowInsideKindOf = INFANTRY
    TimeForFullHeal = 6000
  End
  CommandSet = IronwoodPowerCommandSet
